name: regctl
description: Registry client for copying images and managing container registries with OCI support

regctl.description: Registry client for image operations, copying, and registry management with OCI layout support
regctl.usage:
regctl image copy alpine:latest localhost:5000/alpine:latest
regctl image export alpine:latest alpine.tar
regctl repo ls registry.example.com
regctl image manifest alpine:latest
regctl image config alpine:latest
